Organization 7: Coast Path URL: https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/chemin-de-la-cote/
Website: None Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details 5295 chemin de la
Côte-Sainte-Catherine, Montreal QC H3W 0A1 514 527-5720, ext. 34 Mission The mission of
“Chemin de la Côte” is to offer affordable housing adapted to the needs of people seniors aged 55
and over with low income, thus promoting their well-being and quality of life in the community of
Côte-des-Neiges—Notre-Dame-de-Grâce, in Montreal. Description Located at
Côte-des-Neiges—Notre-Dame-de-Grâce, in Montreal, the Chemin de la Côte organization offers
housing suitable for seniors aged 55 and over. Our mission is to provide a framework secure and
comfortable living environment for seniors with low income, whether they are independent or in
need slight loss of autonomy. We offer different types of accommodation to meet the needs of
varied needs of our customers: Studios: Ideal for people wanting a living space compact and
functional. 3½ accommodations: Offering a separate bedroom for more comfort. 4½
accommodations: Perfect for those who want additional space to accommodate loved ones or for
personal activities. It is important to note that, to ensure a serene environment, animals are not
accepted in our facilities. This policy aims to ensure the well-being of all our residents. At Chemin
de la Côte, we believe in the importance to create an inclusive and welcoming living environment.
Our dedicated team works tirelessly to ensure the comfort and safety of our residents. We
understand that every person has unique needs, and we are committed to providing support
tailored to each individual. For more For information on our services or to plan a visit, do not
hesitate to contact us. Your well-being is our priority.

Organization 8: Foundation of Friends of Childhood (Montreal) inc / Manoir Ronald Mc Donald -
FAEM URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/fondationdesamisdelenfancemontrealinc/ Website:
https://www.manoirmontreal.qc.ca/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details
5800 Ch Hudson, Montréal QC H3S 2G5 514-731-2871 Opening hours SCHEDULE Office hours
are: Monday to Friday from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Saturdays and Sundays from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. Our
offices are open 365 days a year year. Social networks Mission Established in the heart of Montreal
since 1982, the Fondation des Friends of Childhood (Montreal), is a non-profit organization whose
mission is to contribute to well-being of sick children. Operating under the name Ronald McDonald
House of Montreal, the house is a low-cost temporary residence where we welcome parents from
remote areas (more than 55 km) who have a sick child needing care in a hospital Montreal for
children. Description It offers parents a comfortable place, less than five minutes walk from CHU
Sainte-Justine, where they can sleep, prepare their meals and above all, visit their child at a time
that suits them. More than just a residence, the Manor is also a living environment, a place of
solidarity and comfort. Our facilities include: 50 rooms including 7 adapted, they are spread over 4
levels and designed for three people, including a single bed, a double bed, bedding, a full
bathroom, towels, a telephone and the courier service. 2 fully equipped kitchens 1 dining room 3
living rooms with television 1 rest lounge with computers and internet connection 1 library 1
children’s playroom 1 lounge for teenagers 1 terrace with barbecue 1 outdoor play area for children
1 laundry room and laundry room on 04 levels, including washers and dryers, including cleaning
products cleaning Playpens, strollers, high chairs Coffee, tea, milk, bread, eggs, yogurt, herbal tea,
hot chocolate, pastries (on occasion) The room allows privacy if necessary, and the areas common
are spaces where families can cook, eat, rest and share their experiences.

Website: https://www.hapopex.org/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details 445,
rue Jean Talon ouest, Montréal QC H3N1R1 514-583-1378 Opening hours SCHEDULE Monday:
8:30 a.m. to 12 p.m. and 1 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. Tuesday: 8:30 a.m. to 12 p.m. and 1 p.m. to 4:30 p.m.
Wednesday: 1 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. Thursday: 8:30 a.m. to 12 p.m. and 1 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. Friday: 8:30
a.m. to 12 p.m. and 1 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. Mission HAPOPEX (Les Habitations populaire de
Parc-Extension) wishes to help low-income households in Montreal in order to improve their living
conditions accommodation. The main problems experienced by the population are poverty,
unemployment and the lack of suitable housing corresponding to their needs. Description The
Housing Parc-Extension is a non-profit organization created in May 1995 and managed by a board
of directors made up of tenants and organizations concerned about the conditions of life of
low-income households. Hapopex acquires and manages buildings with the aim of offering rental of
decent and affordable housing to people with low or modest incomes. We manage a real estate
portfolio of 375 housing units in 16 buildings spread across the neighborhoods North-Central
Montreal.

Organization 12: Community Housing of Côte-des-Neiges URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/leshabitationscommunautairesdecotedesneiges/
Website: None Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details 6555 Chemin de la
Côte-des-Neiges, , QC H3S 2A6, Montreal QC H3S 2A6 (514) 735-0117 The email address for this
organization is unknown, please contact them by phone. Mission Promote access to quality housing
acceptable for a population with modest income and favor customers who have needs specific.
Actively participate in the development of the neighborhood in the area of housing social and
integration of newcomers in order to offer them help and support in collaboration with local
organisms. Description Located in a very populated area, Les Habitations Communautaires de
Côte-des-Neiges is a non-profit organization that manages housing social (481 housing units and
36 rooms). The organization therefore has 517 housing units distributed across the
Côte-des-Neiges district. The buildings are located on Barclay, Décarie, Decelles, Linton, Mountain
sights, Van Horne and Victoria. The management of these buildings generates income annual
revenues of around 2.5 million dollars. Its workforce is made up of nine employees permanent
employees, one part-time employee and 4 others occasionally recruited as part of employment
assistance programs. Given the proximity of services such as hospitals, the University of Montreal
and the HEC, the demand for housing is very strong. Our clientele is very diverse and
cosmopolitan.

Organization 13: O3 Transitional Homes – On Our Own O3 URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/maisons-transitionnelles-o3-les-on-our-own-o3/
Website: https://www.o3onourown.com/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details
3970 boulevard Cavendish, bureau 1, Montreal QC H4B 2N3 514 369-0757 514 369-2954 Opening
hours SCHEDULE Monday to Friday 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mission The mission of the On Our
Own organization is to help young people vulnerable parents to take charge of their lives with
community support. By offering services and transitional housing, we aim to strengthen families so
that they can build a better future for themselves and their children. Description Houses Transitional
O3 (On Our Own) is a non-profit organization based in Montreal, dedicated to helping vulnerable
young parents and their children. At O3 Transitional Homes, we believe in the power of community
to support families in need. We offer transitional housing and support services to support young
parents in the building a better future for themselves and their children. Our programs put emphasis
on different aspects of personal development, including: Parenting: We offer tips and resources to
help parents build strong family systems. Financial Literacy: Residents work to achieve financial
goals to ensure a stable future. Education and career: We support educational pathways and
development professional. Mental health: Our staff offers support to promote well-being
psychological. Healthy Relationships: We encourage healthy family relationships and balanced.
Healthy lifestyle: We encourage residents to adopt lifestyle choices that promote health. Our
mission is to give residents the means to move towards autonomy, self-determination and a sense
of belonging, so that they can flourish independent. Your support is essential to help us achieve this
goal. If you wish get involved with O3, several options are available to you: Make a donation: Your
contribution allows us to provide affordable housing and programs that change lives. Become
resident: Apply to live at the O3 Transitional Houses and go through the first step towards a
promising future. To find out more about our organization, you can visit our website at
www.o3onourown.com or contact us directly: Homes Transitional O3 (On Our Own) 3970, avenue
Cavendish, bureau 1 Montréal (Québec) H4B 2N3 Telephone: 514-369-0757 Email:
info@o3onourown.com Thank you for supporting the Houses O3 Transitions and help us break the
cycle of poverty, one family at a time.

Organization 14: Ronald McDonald House URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/manoir-ronald-mcdonald/ Website:
https://manoirmontreal.qc.ca/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details 5800
Chemin Hudson, Montréal QC H3S 2G5 514 731-2871 514 739-8823 Opening hours SCHEDULE
Monday: 8:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m. Tuesday: 08:00 – 20:00 Wednesday: 08:00 – 20:00 Thursday: 08:00
– 20:00 Friday: 08:00 – 20:00 Saturday: 09:00 – 8:00 p.m. Sunday: 9:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m. Mission
The mission of the Ronald McDonald House is to provide warm and affordable refuge for parents
whose children receive health care at Montreal. We are providing them with essential support
during this difficult time, ensuring that so that they can stay close to their sick child. Description The
Ronald McDonald House is a temporary residence dedicated to parents of children requiring
medical care in a Montreal hospital. Located in the Côte-des-Neiges—Notre-Dame-de-Grâce
district, this organization offers affordable accommodation, allowing families to be closer to their
children while reducing the financial stress often associated with health care. This initiative is
particularly beneficial for parents from remote regions, located more than 55 km from Montreal. By
offering a comfortable and accessible place to stay, Manoir Ronald McDonald ensures that families
can focus on the well-being of their child, without being distracted by logistical concerns. Services
offered by the Ronald McDonald House include: Affordable temporary accommodation for families
Proximity to hospitals Montrealers, facilitating daily visits Warm and welcoming environment for
families Emotional support and resources to help parents Le Manoir aims to improve quality of life
for families in times of crisis, by offering them a place where they can feel safe security and support.
In addition to accommodation, the organization is committed to creating a network of support
between parents, thus promoting exchanges of experiences and bonds of mutual assistance. In In
conclusion, the Ronald McDonald House is much more than just a place to stay. It's a space where
families can find comfort and solidarity during difficult times. Thanks to its strategic location in
Montreal and its commitment to families, this organization plays a crucial role in the care pathway
for sick children.

Organization 15: Grouping of ethnic Montreal organizations for housing - ROMEL URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/regroupementdesagencesdumontrealet
hniqueforhousing/ Website: http://romel-montreal.ca/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION
Contact details 6555 Côte-des-Neiges, Montréal QC H3S 2A6 514-341-1057 514-341-8404
Opening hours SCHEDULE Monday to Thursday from 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. and 1 p.m. to 5 p.m. Friday
9 a.m. to 12 p.m. and 1 p.m. to 4 p.m. Mission ROMEL is an organization community which works
to improve the housing conditions of poor citizens and ethnic communities. Since 1984 to date, the
Technical Resources Group has carried out more than fifty community real estate projects
(Cooperatives or Non-Profit Organizations Lucratif) in Montreal (1,200 housing units). Description
Created in 1984, ROMEL is an organization non-profit specialized in community real estate
intended for different communities and to new arrivals. Bringing together 45 ethnocultural
organizations, ROMEL works closely collaboration with its member organizations to facilitate the
settlement of newcomers to the host society and the improvement of the housing conditions of
community members cultural. The versatile and multilingual ROMEL team offers the following
services: Support technique in community real estate development (housing, CPE: small childhood
and community centers) Search for rental accommodation Diverse information on housing Property
management
